Name: A Friend in Need - Sell Your Furniture
Author: JaneElliot
Description:
[size=4][b]Help out a friend in need by donating your furniture (and everything else!)[/b][/size]

[i](Admittedly, you get the full price of the items sold, so this is less of a charity and more of a "charity", but it does give you an alternative to storing or trashing all of the unwanted items you encounter in the game. Note that some items - tools, hats, etc. - have no sale price associated with them, but you can still toss them in the box.)

[/i][b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Dropbox where you can trade in items for a "tax rebate advance" that is equal to the buy price of the items.  At this point, I think every item in the game can be put in the box.  Be careful not to put in something you want to keep - once you close the store window, the item is lost forever!
[*]A few item categories (like tools and hats) do not have a built-in sale price, so for now you can only donate them.
[*]The dropbox is located where you first enter the Bus Stop, in front of the left-most tree.
[/list]
[b]Compatibility:
[/b][list]
[*][b]Compatible with the Hardware Store mod.[/b] The drop off bin is partially covered by the Hardware Store, but the bin, the store, and the vending machine are all still accessible.  (It actually looks like the bin is tucked in behind the Hardware Store, which I love from a lore perspective.)
[*]Compatible with expansions, maps, etc. that do not edit the Bus Stop (specifically tested and compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, Visit Mt. Vapius, and Sunberry Village).
[*]Should be compatible with most maps that do edit the Bus Stop, as this mod only affects 4 tiles.  That said, NOT compatible with Prettier Bus Stop (as it edits the same four tiles).
[*]Theoretically, compatible with any mod that uses Content Patcher to add items to the game.
[/list][b]
Installation[/b]:
[list]
[*]Requires Content Patcher version 2.4 or later
[*]Unzip the file and copy to your Mods folder
[/list]
Thank you to OnionNinja, FSHXY, and the Stardew Discord Modding group for coding assistance and support!  Please report any bugs/typos. [b] Enjoy![/b]
